title: Born elsewhere, early drumming, medicine show and dance trio
summary: He was born in Bogalusa and moved to New Orleans as a baby; he played trap drums at seven to nine, worked a short stint with a medicine show, then danced in a trio.

story.theme_name: First paying gigs: getting started as a young professional
story.community_name: First paid gigs: pay, bands and young beginnings
